description: The loop cannot earn end-to-end: there is no submission path and no account, anywhere. A grep of /Users/anicca/.openclaw/.env for code4rena|cantina|sherlock|warden returns NO matches, and there is no submit code in run.sh or audit-cli.sh — the entire 'submit' step is a prose disclaimer ('Real SUBMIT needs a code4rena/Cantina account', run.sh:6-7, audit-cli.sh:4). So the realized pipeline is: discover (closed contests, FIND-001) -> execute writes a .target.json placeholder (FIND-004) -> brain MAY draft state/findings/<id>.md -> DEAD END. This is the same 'deliverable with no delivery channel' dead-end as the gig slot. Being honestly flagged does not make it a loop that can earn — as built, the maximum possible earnings is structurally 0 because no path to a paid submission exists, and the analyzed target is a closed contest anyway.

evidence.snippet: execute(){ ... echo "{...draft_target...}" > "$STATE/findings/$id.target.json"; emit "... Submission account = honest gap." }  # no submit, no account referenced anywhere in repo or .env
